name: Sr. Avila
description: A family man experiences the tremendous burden of leading a double life as a professional hitman.

videos.title: Surprise Party
videos.overview: Ybarra and Ávila are a couple of guys living apparently predictable, routine lives, whose real occupation is murder by contract. The next assignment will put their friendship to the test.

videos.title: By the Book
videos.overview: Ávila has to carry out the toughest assignment of his career. His life is getting complicated, and is about to take an unexpected.

videos.title: A Lousy Job
videos.overview: Ávila accepts Sr. Moreira’s proposal. With a new apprentice and a tough case on his hands, he is looking for “stability” in his life.

videos.title: A Stranger In The Mirror
videos.overview: Ávila tackles a difficult mission and ends up indebted to Ismael, as Moreira, caught in a losing battle, decides to throw in the towel.

videos.title: Sr. Ávila
videos.overview: Ávila becomes Señor Ávila, the boss, and inherits problems that threaten the company’s reputation for reliability. Iván will help him to solve some of them.

videos.title: Reliquaries and Vampires
videos.overview: Sr. Ávila handles his first case, tries to find Maggie and is about to learn some of the unwritten rules of the business.

videos.title: To Kill an Immortal
videos.overview: Ávila discovers how complicated it is to do away with someone who is immortal, and Emiliano comes across a strange connection between Ismael and his father.

videos.title: God’s Whims
videos.overview: Sr. Ávila seeks help, both earthly and divine, to handle the case of the “immortal,” as the police close in on Ismael and Emiliano.

videos.title: The Child and The Spiderweb
videos.overview: Emiliano will make a mistake that leaves Ismael exposed, as María discovers new deceptions by Ávila and comes dangerously close to the truth.

videos.title: Neither Borges, Nor God
videos.overview: Ismael’s story is revealed, as Detective Sánchez closes in on the real Sr. Ávila.

videos.title: Freud and Ghosts
videos.overview: Juliana’s case is closed, Sánchez is acting on his own, and Ismael is believed to be dead. Sr. Ávila feels relieved. But not for long.

videos.title: That Day
videos.overview: Sr. Ávila makes mistakes, and fate places Sánchez within reach of the truth to unmask him.

videos.title: A Child’s Gaze
videos.overview: Ávila is going to pay a high price for being the Boss of the business, as Ismael approaches his fate. They both know their days are numbered…

videos.title: Christ's Hitman
videos.overview: Sr. Ávila lives in torment, under threat of death, and receives an “assignment” to kill someone who is the same age his son would be. María, confined to a mental hospital, doesn’t remember a thing.

videos.title: Pies in The Face
videos.overview: Ávila does what he believes he must to keep on being the “Boss” of the business.

videos.title: The Master and The Watchmaker
videos.overview: As Ávila gets closer to the real Iván and certain secrets of his secretary’s past come to light, Sánchez and Erika make a crucial discovery.

videos.title: Playing To Be Someone Else
videos.overview: Gumming up the execution of someone else’s contract is a most serious offense in this business; however, Ávila might just be willing to run the risk.

videos.title: Compensation
videos.overview: In the business of death, when two “bosses” face off, only the two of them can personally agree on a settlement. The injured party is the one who sets the price.

videos.title: The Good and The Bad Master
videos.overview: The “Board of Directors” meets to settle the impasse between Ávila and the Croat. Its verdicts are final and not subject to any appeal.

videos.title: A Shot in the Mouth
videos.overview: With the help of Iván, Sr. Ávila stays one step ahead of the unpredictable. María suffers an attack and lets go. Erika discovers information that is of interest to Ávila.

videos.title: Beast's Mercy
videos.overview: Ávila is ready to dig up the secrets surrounding Emiliano’s death, as well as bury any evidence that gets in his way.

videos.title: El Señor Juarez
videos.overview: The son of Señor Juárez decides to speed up the natural course of events and asks Ávila for help, as Erika keeps getting closer and closer.

videos.title: Boss of Bosses
videos.overview: The war of the Bosses will be declared: the one who knows best how to apply the rules will win. In the end, Ávila will receive his absolution, but at a very high price.

videos.title: A Clown Roars Into the Night
videos.overview: Señor Ávila is now the “Boss of Bosses.” Hanging onto this job is going to be even tougher than the road he’s travelled so far.

videos.title: The Woman Without a Face
videos.overview: The Boss of Bosses is faced with a tricky case: a hit where no one knows who the victim will be, where the client has gone, or who is going to do the deed.

videos.title: The Hacking Bells
videos.overview: When a mysterious woman vanishes, signs point to a mole in the organization.

videos.title: Puzzle of Faces
videos.overview: El Buitre is hiding much more than money. A mystery. Possibly an alliance. A mole and a hit that must be stopped.

videos.title: Gentlemen, Place Your Bets
videos.overview: A chance event brings startling revelations to light. Ávila enters into a dangerous alliance.

videos.title: Too Long of a Night
videos.overview: A high-value hostage badly wounded, a killer who knows too much. The time has come to take a stand and make alliances.

videos.title: Rumors About a Dead Man
videos.overview: A failed attempted murder brings to light a mysterious criminal organization. All of the past comes back.

videos.title: A Ghost Named Molina
videos.overview: Sr. Ávila and Iván are on the trail of a ghost. The testimony of a mysterious witness will be decisive.

videos.title: Puppets and Puppeteers
videos.overview: Unexpected witnesses and furtive encounters mark a hunt for a ghost. Who is pulling the strings?

videos.title: Twelve Names
videos.overview: Ávila gets to where he is going, willing to do anything; perhaps the only ending he can manage will turn out to be his own.

videos.title: Above and Below the Don
videos.overview: Sr. Avila is a slave to himself and, even more so, to the organization. Fear has settled inside him, and also a deep desire to take revenge. Returning from death, Avila has won a new and unexpected ally and is more determined than ever to fulfill his destiny.

videos.title: Respectfully
videos.overview: Avila entrusts Alvarado with a secret and very special case. Meanwhile, Ivan becomes increasingly obsessed with power and status, and Sanchez makes a new friend in AA.

videos.title: God's Hobby
videos.overview: Avila seems to gain ground against Cardozo; Ivan receives a new assignment; and Sanchez investigates the death of an old woman. Meanwhile, in the funeral home, Ana exerts more influence.

videos.title: The Embalmed Wolf Is Asleep
videos.overview: Ávila and Molina form an alliance based on mutual mistrust, and decide to go ahead with their plans. But they have to cross a minefield. Sánchez tells Ávila who the old lady’s killer is. An unexpected return puts Ávila in a very risky situation. Cardozo puts him under pressure. He does not trust Ávila, who knows that if he challenges him, he could be in great danger.

videos.title: All Or Nothing
videos.overview: To put their plans for revenge into practice, Ávila and Molina will have to go to war. Cardozo calls everyone to account and defends his actions. A meeting with Ávila appears inevitable.

videos.title: Be Careful What You Wish For
videos.overview: Guzmán has become the Boss, but longs for the time when he was just a simple soldier. He has always been a loyal and faithful servant and knows he is in a risky situation, so decides to seek help. But maybe it is already too late.

videos.title: The Ways of The Boss
videos.overview: Skillfully and cunningly, Ávila is advancing his plans. Iván is having a relationship with Maca and tells her some of his secrets and details of his past. Sánchez is temporarily out of the picture and a storm is approaching.

videos.title: My Way
videos.overview: El Buitre and Sánchez are surrounded and will have to take action to avoid the inevitable. Laura Duarte reappears and is just about to escape again. Ávila’s revenge is almost complete.

videos.title: Get Away From Me!
videos.overview: The Justice Department has issued a warrant for the arrest of Roberto Ávila for a string of murders. The Council of the Bosses is in panic, but Ávila appears to be the only target. Cardozo is safe. Ávila confronts Molina.

videos.title: Kill First, Live Better After
videos.overview: Ávila is confronted by Cardozo. Iván recalls his crimes. Sánchez closes the circle and arrives at the precinct. Molina settles his debts. The final meeting will be where it all began, in the funeral parlor, and where it all may end.
